Maya (Docs): Quick heads-up: we've standardized how we describe retry settings in the SDK docs. Old examples used `retries`; canonical param will be `retry_policy`. Please review.
Ethan (SDK): Is this just the docs or is the SDK surface changing?
Maya (Docs): Docs-first. We want SDK examples, samples and generated docs to use `retry_policy` to be explicit (backoff, max_attempts, idempotency).
Nora (Eng): Backend accepts both keys for now. No runtime change, but agreed that `retry_policy` is clearer for routing and telemetry tagging.
Ravi (Product): Timeline: update docs and examples today, push SDK sample updates in the next minor, keep aliasing for 6 months then warn.
Ethan (SDK): We'll add a small compatibility shim that maps `retries` -> `retry_policy` and add deprecation warnings in logs. Also update CLI and config templates.
Maya (Docs): Proposed canonical snippet to use in docs and samples:
```
client.request.create(
  model="r-complete-002",
  input="Hello",
  retry_policy={"max_attempts":3, "backoff_ms":200}
)
```
Replace `retries: 3` with above structured `retry_policy`.
Ethan (SDK): Good. Will update js/py/go sample generators and add a migration note.
Nora (Eng): Ops: we'll tag telemetry with `retry.policy=v2` when `retry_policy` is used so customers can track adoption.
Maya (Docs): Added a migration FAQ: "How do I map old retries to retry_policy?" short answer: `retries: N` -> `retry_policy: {max_attempts:N, backoff_ms:200}` (and encourage exponential backoff).
Ethan (SDK): PRs opened for sample updates: js-sdk#1932, py-sdk#947. Will link once CI passes.
docs-bot: [automated] docs page updated: /docs/guides/retry-and-retries (revision 2026-04-12T10:15Z)
Maya (Docs): Please :thumbsup: when your parts are done so I can close the rollout checklist.
Ravi (Product): Adding a short note for AMs: "No immediate runtime break. Examples now prefer `retry_policy`. We'll support old `retries` for 6 months and provide migration help."
Ethan (SDK): :thumbsup:
Nora (Eng): :thumbsup:
